main_text.p: ⲡⲁⲁⲥ̈ⲱ̈ⲥ̈ⲁⲗ, πολλαὶ, ἀλλὰ, &c. verfutus, vafer, dolofus, impoftor; to cheat, & a cheater. Sciat autem Lector hac additione non id agere nos, ut noftra collectio crefcat, cum legenti plurima quotidie fe offerant, quæ prudens prætereo: fed quòd illa præcipuè verba fint ad id quod volumus & hoc opere fufcepimus obfervatione ante alia digniffima, in quibus πολυσημία verbi Anglici, πολυσημία Græci refpondet. Tale verbum χειμάζω, & χείμασμα; de quo pag. 211. &c. & 215. In collectione autem, multa. Vide in Λύω, & Λύω in λέγω; λύω; & ὅλλυμι; & in μανιάχης; ὀρίζω, &c. Dicam liberè, quod sentio. Vix ulla lingua, Italica, Hispanicâve, suæ traductionis indicia majora aut manifestiora suppeditat. Jam ubi de declinationibus & casuum Saxonicorum terminatione agimus, etiam de Accusativo Saxonico debuimus addere, quæ more Græco in n ut plurimùm definere certum est. Exempla satis obvia; nec nobis nunc immorari vacat.
main_text.head: FINIS.

page.notes: Greek words are transcribed approximately from a small, damaged print; several Greek forms (first line, Λύω/Λύω, μανιάχης) are doubtful and should be checked against the scan. The page-number and running head are clear. Sign-like marks near the margins are not text.
